Exclude anisotropy, toon, clearcoat, IBL and custom material code; radiance remains linear, display color management pending.

torus_adaptation.scope: Retain torus position/normal/UV and exact seam construction; reverse winding to CCW. Use bounded major radius and tube ratio; omit tangents and UV2 outside project vertex contract.

transparency_sorting_reference.scope: Adopt opaque-first and stable transparent back-to-front object ordering. Use the transformed mesh bounds center instead of an instance origin; use camera distance for perspective and view depth for orthographic projection. Add the Godot -128..127 material render priority and per-instance sorting offset to the project graph/value contracts. Alpha depth prepass and intersecting-geometry transparency remain outside this increment.
